designs.name: SOI220_cband, oband_Grating Coupler_off-the-shelf_03/2026_main()
designs.comments: Cornerstone off-the-shelf chip with all standard component in PIC-library by following the Phix packaging protocol. With 127- and 250-nm pitch loopback grating coupler arrays. directional coupler and ring resonator to characterize the waveguide and coupling conditions. Two type of delay line: spiral and racetrack for line-distance performance.

Two type of delay line: spiral and racetrack for line-distance performance.
